method: Bounded web discovery of primary WFP, HDX, IPC, World Bank and FEWS NET publications; followed by direct reproducible HTTP probes in requests.json.
queries: site:data.humdata.org Ethiopia food prices historical wage 2015
site:ipcinfo.org API shapefile assessment ID geospatial data download
site:reliefweb.int/report/yemen monthly market watch 2015 wage (no results returned)

primary_findings.finding: HDX describes the 2018 transition from a manually uploaded global file to automatically updated country exports. This motivates checking both the legacy and current global resource inventories.

The publisher's March 2015 bulletin includes wage/wheat-flour terms-of-trade charts for named Yemen markets and credits WFP VAM. It confirms that earlier descriptive observations existed; the chart does not supply an exact-ID monthly raw quote archive suitable for automatic splicing.
The January-June 2015 outlook describes regional agricultural wages and grain prices. Narrative ranges are not exact-market, exact-series monthly observations.
World Bank Real Time Prices combines direct measurements with machine-learning estimation of missing prices and adjusts outliers. It cannot be imported as observed WFP wage/food baseline data.

Official IPC API provides detailed population tables and GeoJSON/vector maps for analysis units. Approved requests receive API keys; the public documentation links the technical schema. No access request or authenticated API call made.

interpretation: No claim that all archives have been exhaustively searched. A failed HTTP request or missing identity crosswalk remains an unresolved dependency, not evidence that data never existed.
